title: Two tests lock in that a past special day vanishes without a word
what: The gym timings checks, both in the panel and on the server, require a special day whose date is already over to be dropped quietly on save. The journey says that must never happen without a word, so these tests will fail any fix and keep the silent drop in place.
expected: The tests expect the owner to be told that a special day is already over (or the save to say it was left out).
how_often: every save with an old special day
fix_line: Change both tests to expect a visible word when a past special day is left out

title: Gym timings: Saving, double tap, Keep them and the 30-day cap are never tested
what: The one timings screen test never checks the 'Saving' button, a double tap, the 'Keep them' answer on the remove question, the limit of 30 special days, the 'Pick the one closest' line, or that members see nothing before Save. The failure and offline cards are already listed elsewhere.
expected: The timings screen test also taps Save twice, taps Keep them, tries a 31st special day and checks the Saving state.
fix_line: Add these steps to the existing timings screen test

title: Today's Birthdays and Came in today tiles are never checked on screen
what: No browser test reads the 'Birthdays today' or 'Came in today' tile, opens the register or birthday list from them, checks a brand-new gym shows no wall of zero tiles, or checks that archiving or a check-in moves a tile. These are checked only as counting rules.
expected: A Today screen test checks every tile, the list each one opens, a new gym with no tiles, and the tiles moving after a check-in, an undone visit and an archive.
fix_line: Add a Today tiles screen test for the missing tiles and changes

title: Today tiles are never tested for a gym with two branches
what: No test opens Today on one branch of a two-branch gym, as owner or as a front desk of one branch, and checks that members, money and birthdays of the other branch are left out. The branch test only checks the member list and the 'All branches' page.
expected: A test with two branches checks each branch's Today numbers, and a desk of one branch sees only its own members and no money.
fix_line: Add a two-branch Today test for owner and desk

title: HQ messages in the bell are tested only for the owner
what: The only screen test of HQ messages signs in as the owner. Nothing checks the bell for a front desk or trainer, that a message's button appears only for a page that login may open, that the demo gym shows no HQ messages, that an http link gets no button (only a javascript link is tried), or that an https link opens in a new tab.
expected: Screen tests show an HQ message to staff and a trainer, a button hidden for a page they may not open, the demo gym, and http and https links.
fix_line: Add staff, trainer, demo and link cases to the HQ message tests

title: Importing members into several branches is never tried on screen
what: Every check of a branch import is a rule check. No browser test shows 'Branches in your file', the pick for an unknown name, 'Skip these rows', the per-sheet branch pick, the result branch by branch, or the line saying each branch has its own Past imports.
expected: A screen test imports one file into two branches, picks a branch for an unknown name, skips one, and undoes in one branch.
fix_line: Add one screen test of a two-branch import

title: Some ways an Aadhaar number could slip into an import are never tested
what: No test fixes a row under 'Rows to check' and checks the ID number is still cut, imports the same file twice and compares, writes an Aadhaar in Hindi digits or odd separators, or checks that the skipped-rows download has no ID number. The on-screen promise line and the 'read as usual' line are never checked.
expected: Tests cover the fixed row, the second import, Hindi-digit and odd-separator Aadhaar numbers, and the skipped-rows file.
fix_line: Add these four cases to the ID number tests

title: Import refusals and the fill-in-blanks choice are never seen on screen
what: No test shows the over-5 MB line, the not-an-Excel line, the first-2000-rows line, the 'Skip them / Fill in their blank details' choice, the 'Update' button words, 'Reading the file', or the sheet pick for a workbook. They are checked only as rules or not at all.
expected: Screen tests pick a too-big file, a wrong file, a 2001-row file, a file with existing members (fill in blanks) and a workbook with two sheets.
fix_line: Add these files to the import screen tests
